title: State types for machine phases
statement: For each natural number $k$, assign a state type to every control key as follows: the entry and halt keys have a singleton state type; the lookup key has states consisting of a seek key together with the corresponding seek-phase state; the state-tail, state-home, table-tail, table-home, state-gap, and state-restore keys have seek-phase states; the clear-state key has sweep-phase states; the to-summary, to-state, and finish keys have states in a three-element set; the record key has record states of width $4k+4$; and the successor key has successor-phase states.
